option_relations.rationale: Severe Myocarditis is a specific, severe form of viral myocarditis, making viral myocarditis a broader category.
Severe Myocarditis can be a manifestation or component of Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C), making MIS-C a broader diagnostic entity that can encompass severe myocarditis.
Severe Myocarditis can be a complication or component of bacterial sepsis with myocardial involvement, making bacterial sepsis a broader diagnostic entity that can encompass severe myocarditis.

Severe Myocarditis can be a component of COVID-19 with cardiac injury and thrombocytopenia-associated multiple organ failure (TAMOF), making this option a broader diagnostic entity that can encompass severe myocarditis.
